hypotheses.claim: A release-critical Frank value should preserve one semantic identity across cognition, typed IR, authority, persistence, Needle lowering, verified outcome and re-entry.
hypotheses.prediction: Changing representation or Needle implementation does not change semantic identity, authority, provenance or generation fields visible to Frank.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Adapters can remain semantically correct without a shared native value identity if differential validation is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched alternate-lowering replay finds no semantic or authority divergence across restart/recovery and adversarial stale inputs.

hypotheses.claim: Selected semantic-lineage head CAS plus an independently surviving recovery/execution-generation authority can reject divergent sibling continuation and stale effect authority within a declared failure domain.
hypotheses.prediction: Concurrent equal-parent siblings yield one selected successor and any old generation cannot execute after turnover/recovery.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: The lineage selector and generation authority can fail or roll back together, recreating ambiguity or stale authority.
hypotheses.falsifier: Composed target-VPS rollback/restart campaign produces two accepted successors or permits an old generation to pass B1/B2/B3.

hypotheses.claim: Effect DONE/re-entry requires exact referential closure to execution generation plus canonical causal support identities, not merely provider success or identity metadata.
hypotheses.prediction: Missing, fabricated, foreign or stale episode/use/causal-credit/delta support fails closed or follows an explicit typed no-learning path.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Generation identity plus provider outcome alone is sufficient for terminal correctness.
hypotheses.falsifier: Weaker identity-only design remains correct under fabricated/foreign/stale support injection and replay/recovery.

hypotheses.claim: WAL-backed recovery evidence on the target cannot be promoted until exact SQLite fix/backport provenance is verified or the production topology machine-proves the upstream race unreachable.
hypotheses.prediction: Unverified target SQLite 3.45.1 package remains fail-closed for affected multi-connection WAL recovery claims.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Ubuntu already backported the relevant SQLite repair or Frank's exact topology excludes every trigger condition.
hypotheses.falsifier: Primary package/source provenance proves the backport, or a machine-checked topology plus stress evidence excludes the documented race.

hypotheses.claim: Hyperposition should remain conditional rather than default: higher-order representation earns complexity only when a pairwise/simpler projection loses task-relevant invariants or outcomes.
hypotheses.prediction: Selected workloads demonstrate a measurable invariant/outcome loss under pairwise reduction that typed Hyperposition preserves within budget.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Weighted pairwise topology is Pareto-equal or better on Frank v0.1 workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched target workloads show no task-relevant loss from pairwise reduction.

hypotheses.claim: GWT causal evidence requires exact selection -> delivery -> reconstruction -> use -> local effect -> outcome -> re-entry identity closure; ignition/integration alone is insufficient.
hypotheses.prediction: Mechanisms that increase integration without receiver-use mediation fail matched lesion/intervention outcome prediction.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Simpler integration observables predict intervention outcomes as well as the complete receipt chain.
hypotheses.falsifier: Integration-only model is Pareto-equal on held-out causal interventions.
evidence: recent reboot-focus and sibling-quorum negative results

hypotheses.claim: Multimodal perception is Clay-Machine compatible only when percept identity, feature epoch, uncertainty and provenance enter cognition as typed Clay values while tensors/embeddings remain physical backing.
hypotheses.prediction: Percept semantic identity survives persistence, GWT use, outcome attribution and re-entry without raw model/provider structures becoming authority.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: A looser embedding/text projection is sufficient without semantic identity loss.
hypotheses.falsifier: Differential replay shows the looser projection preserves exact percept provenance, open-set state and causal attribution across feature-epoch change/restart.

hypotheses.claim: Semantic unity does not require physical unity: EUDI/single-image storage remains a candidate only if it beats split layout under recovery, integrity, resource and security controls without changing Clay semantics.
hypotheses.prediction: Either physical layout can host the same semantic value world; storage placement itself must not mint truth, identity, salience or authority.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: One physical image is necessary to preserve semantic identity/continuity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Split layout preserves all semantic/authority invariants and is Pareto-equal or superior on recovery/resources.

experiment_summary: On accepted target VPS, freeze one real typed semantic effect/state identity and drive it through cognition-facing typed state, UnifiedDB, B1/B2/B3 authority, alternate Needle lowerings, provider simulator/controlled provider, VerifiedOutcome and re-entry while injecting sibling-lineage race, local snapshot rollback, process restart, stale-generation replay, provider ACK blackhole, WAL checkpoint/reset stress and provenance/support corruption. Require one selected successor, no duplicate effect, stale rejection before realization, exact identity/provenance preservation and deterministic recovery closure.
